errors.evidence: The x-axis has labels for every two years (2000, 2002, 2004, etc.), not for every year.
In 2002, the line reaches a peak at approximately 1.00, not 0.96. The value 0.96 is explicitly labeled for the year 2001.
In the year 2004, the value on the line is approximately 0.97, not 0.95.
